# Frontmatter for `type: note`

<!-- GENERATED by taxidermist from taxonomy/. Do not hand-edit: edit the schema and run `taxidermist docs`. -->

Composes `core`, the field bundles in [../traits.yaml](../traits.yaml).

## Copy this

```yaml
---
type: note
title: <str>
topic: <garden | hiring | house | infra>
date: <date>
tags: []   # optional
people: []   # optional
status: <draft | final>   # optional
review:   # optional
  open: <bool>
  when: <date>   # optional
---
```

**`review` is required only when `status: final`.**

## What to put in each field

**`type`** · required · `str`  
The doctype. Fixed per file; it selects this schema.

**`title`** · required · `str`  
The name a person would say, not the filename.

**`topic`** · required · `str`  
The one topic this file sits under.

Values: `garden` · `hiring` · `house` · `infra`, defined below.

**`date`** · required · `date`  
When it happened, not when the file was written.

**`tags`** · optional · `list`  
Free-text keywords. Not checked; use `topic` for anything you filter on.

**`people`** · optional · `list`  
Slugs of the pages under people/ this file is about.

Values: any page under [`people/`](../../people/), by its filename without `.md`. Checked, so a name that resolves to no page is a fault.

**`status`** · optional · `str`  
The note's own lifecycle.

Values: `draft` · `final`, defined below.

**`review`** · optional · `object`  
The review a final note went through.

- `open` · required · `bool`: false once the review is done.
- `when` · optional · `date`: When to look again.

## What the values mean

### `topic`

Shared vocabulary from [../vocabularies/topic.yaml](../vocabularies/topic.yaml).

| value | group | means | not for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `garden` | home | Anything that grows. |  |
| `hiring` | work | Recruiting, interviews, onboarding. |  |
| `house` | home | Repairs and the things that break. |  |
| `infra` | work | Servers, deploys, the build. | Hiring for the infra team; that is `hiring`. |

### `status`

| value | means |
|---|---|
| `draft` | Still being written. |
| `final` | Done; a reviewer has signed off. |

## Adding a value

A field's `definitions` keys **are** its allowed values, so a value cannot exist until someone writes down what it means. Prefer an existing one, because a near-synonym fragments every filter. If nothing fits, add it to the right file under [..](../README.md) with its one line, in the same change that uses it. `taxidermist check` blocks the commit otherwise.
